# miku-ms-office-core-java vendor

This directory vendors the `miku-ms-office-core-java` release jar used by
`miku-md2xlsx-java` for low-level Office package ZIP/OPC/XML helpers.

- Source repository: <https://github.com/igapyon/miku-ms-office-core-java>
- Release: `v0.5.1`
- File: `miku-ms-office-core-0.5.1.jar`
- SHA-256: `e1b4e4804a5e712fad4d91996dd18890782b5e1c53c76a2b17f7fe50c62c5014`

`miku-md2xlsx-java` keeps product-specific XLSX generation semantics in this
repository. The vendored jar owns product-neutral ZIP / OPC package plumbing.
